name: @pipeworx/mcp-europeana

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Europeana collection by keyword. Returns matching items with ids (pass an id to record), titles, creators, dates and image links.

_apiKey.description: Europeana API key (auto-injected by the platform; or pass your own).

tools.name: record
tools.description: Fetch full details for one Europeana item by id — a Europeana record id (the "id" field from search, e.g. "/2021601/foo").

_apiKey.description: Europeana API key (auto-injected by the platform; or pass your own).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-europeana forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the europeana pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
